column2: sched: Make tc-related drop reason more flexible

column1: Currently
express a basic SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_INGRESS or SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_EGRESS reason.
Victor kicked-off an initial proposal to make this more flexible by disambiguating
verdict from return code by moving the verdict into struct tcf_result and
letting tcf_classify() return a negative error. If hit
reasons were added in the proposal
as well as SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_EGRESS_ERROR. Further analysis of the actual
error codes would have required to attach to tcf_classify via kprobe/kretprobe
to more deeply debug skb and the returned error.
In order to make the kfree_skb_reason() in sch_handle_{ingress
extensible
column2: it can be addressed in a more straight forward way

column1: of placing the verdict into struct tcf_result
column2: we can just put the drop reason

column1: in there
column2: which does not require changes throughout various classful schedulers

column1: given the existing verdict logic can stay as is.
Then
column3: _*} can be added to the enum skb_drop_reason

column1: to disambiguate between an error or an intentional drop. New drop reason error
codes can be added successively to the tc code base.
For internal error locations which have not yet been annotated with a
SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_ERROR{
SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_EGRESS
column2: respectively. Generic errors could be marked with a

column1: SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_ERROR code until they are converted to more specific ones
if it is found that they would be useful for troubleshooting.
While drop reasons have infrastructure for subsystem specific error codes which
are currently used by mac80211 and ovs
column2: Jakub mentioned that it is preferred

column1: for tc to use the enum skb_drop_reason core codes given it is a better fit and
currently the tooling support is better
With regards to the latter:
[...] I think Alastair (bpftrace) is working on auto-prettifying enums when
bpftrace outputs maps. So we can do something like:
$ bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:skb:kfree_skb { @[args->reason] = count(); }'
Attaching 1 probe...
^C
@[SKB_DROP_REASON_TC_INGRESS]: 2
@[SKB_CONSUMED]: 34
Auto-magically. [...]
Add a small helper tcf_set_drop_reason() which can be used to set the drop reason
into the tcf_result.
